title: Just Say it Already!
description: A film to warm the heart. Two writers, normally brilliant with words, can’t find the right ones when it really counts.
altHero: a hippo and cheetah in workout clothes in the park standing awkwardly
alt1: hippo and cheetah through windows, both working on typewriters in two separate buildings
alt2: two hands reaching for the same book on a shelf
alt3: hippo and cheetah standing awkwardly at a subway door
alt4: hippo and cheetah awkwardly paddling two separate boats on a lake
